source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_dispatcher.py tests/test_codex_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_minimax_adapter.py

claims.claim: The shared NativeExecutionPolicy retains the 180-minute response budget and finite 185-minute process watchdog.
PRIMARY, REMEDIATION and REPAIR share that policy across all three adapters, preserving existing model selection and mutation authority.
Timeout handling remains terminal, preserves original captured diagnostics, and leaves absent exit status unknown.
Early responses return directly, with the existing single-invocation guard preventing redispatch and retry.

Synthetic regression coverage remains intact. The corrected Antigravity assertion requires --dangerously-skip-permissions exactly when mutation is authorized, retaining accept-edits and read-only checks.
